people.name: Isaah Yeo
people.extract: Isaah Patrick Ferguson-Yeo is an Australian professional rugby league footballer who co-captains and plays as a lock forward for the Penrith Panthers in the NRL and captains New South Wales in State of Origin and Australia at international level.
highlights: Co-captains Penrith Panthers in the NRL.
Captains New South Wales in State of Origin.

people.name: Sun Yue (basketball)
people.extract: Sun Yue is a Chinese former professional basketball player. He won an NBA championship with the Los Angeles Lakers in 2009, making him one of two players born in China to win an NBA championship, the other being Mongolian-Chinese center Mengke Bateer, who won the 2003 NBA Finals with the San Antonio Spurs.
highlights: Won 2009 NBA championship with Los Angeles Lakers.
One of two China-born NBA champions.
